defs.def: after a long time, especially when there has been some difficulty or delay 终于；最终

ex.s: What made Reisley finally decide to settle down in Usonia?
ex.t: 是什么让Reisley最终决定在Usonia定居？

ex.s: When I finally started to study, I would race through the assigned work, often well past midnight.
ex.t: 等我终于开始学习时，我会匆匆忙忙赶完布置的作业，常常早已过了午夜。

ex.s: They _____48_____ at first, unwilling to take a risk, but I finally _____49_____ to get the green light,” she says.
ex.t: 他们起初____犹豫不决，不愿冒险，但我最终____获得了许可，"她说。

ex.s: Ivy finally realised: Jealousy doesn’t come from the success of others — it comes when we forget our own ___9___.

ex.s: The spider tried and failed six times before finally succeeding.
ex.t: 考虑传达信息的最佳方式。

ex.t: 最后，我们提前两分钟赶到了汽车站。

ex.t: 最终，我完成了一个优雅的实验，如果没有实验室成员的帮助，这是不可能的。

ex.s: Talking about food encouraged her parents to finally open up about their past, like the fact that her father had owned a Chinatown restaurant in the 1940s.
ex.t: 介绍一个新的艺术欣赏研究领域。

ex.t: 一系列事件和人物。

ex.t: 我环顾四周，终于看到了David，他独自站在围栏旁边的一侧。

ex.t: 最初几天，凯南总是有点失望幼崽不在那里。

ex.s: However, becoming a full-time, successful actor would still be an uphill battle for another eight years until he landed a number of film roles that finally got him noticed.
ex.t: 尼尔森总觉得他应该演喜剧但他英俊的外表和独特的嗓音让他忙于正剧角色。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日那天我们收集物品的所有努力终于汇聚在一起．当我看到我们收集的各种物资时我突然意识到我们当天要制作的每一个包裹最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中．在过去四个月里我从没想过项目完成后我会是什么感觉．在制作包裹的过程中我意识到我已经忘记了它背后的真正意义．我只把它当作又一个学校项目而且我想在这个项目上取得好成绩．当包裹完成准备运往海外时那种温暖的感觉是我永远不会忘记的．

ex.s: It’s better to leave your listeners wishing for more than shifting restlessly in their seats waiting for your speech finally to end.
ex.t: 做相反的事。

ex.s: Nicolo and another bidder ___46___ until Nicolo finally won the paintings for $32.

ex.s: I didn't feel as though I needed to keep up with anybody else; I was finally with peers who understood me.
ex.t: 我感觉不需要跟上任何人；我终于和懂我的同龄人在一起了。

ex.s: Afterwards, she and her father secured their first business meeting with a supermarket owner, who finally agreed to sell  Moore's product-Cancandy.
ex.t: 她还向牙医请教了更多关于清洁牙齿的知识。

ex.s: Finally, an attractive quality when job-hunting is a great attitude toward potential job.
ex.t: 但他们必须意识到就业市场是关于员工如何适应公司，而不是反过来。

ex.s: I finally quit delivering newspapers and didn’t see Mrs Stanley for several years.
ex.t: 每当有人因为关心你而问候你的近况时——而不是因为他们拿了钱才这么做——你就会发现社区的存在。

ex.s: Finally, the moment of our departure arrived, and we loaded suitcases, books, games, camping equipment, and a tent into the car and bravely drove off.

defs.def: in a way that ends all discussion about sth 彻底地；决定性地

ex.s: When I finally finished it, the thought of winning had given way to the enjoyment of writing.
ex.t: 当我终于完成时，获胜的念头已经让位于写作的乐趣。

ex.s: When I finally finished it, the thought of winning had given way to the enjoyment of writing.

ex.s: But when he finally reached her, the woman flooded him with questions: "Who are you？What antique shop？" However, when she hung up, she regretted the way she had handled the call.
ex.t: 但当他终于联系上她时，这位女士连珠炮似地问了他很多问题："你是谁？哪家古董店？"然而，当她挂断电话后，她后悔自己处理这次通话的方式。
